{{Quote|In the camp just beyond us are some crates of stolen goods. Go get those for me.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sola Hus|Hus]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RSG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Recovering Stolen Goods|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Braggan's Fist Camp''' was the main camp of the [[Braggan's Fist]], a group of criminals on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The thugs had established their camp half a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] outside of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].

==History==
{{Quote|I'm staking out these thugs. I have to figure out a way to get the goods they've stolen back to their rightful owners. Hey, maybe you can help. Would you go into that camp and recover the stolen goods for me?|Sergeant Hus, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> retired [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lt. Col.]] [[Wilfred Quelsh]] asked an independent agent to investigate the theft of his [[Corellian Medal of Honor]]. The agent interrogated several members of the group in the slums of Tyrena until they revealed the location of their main camp. At the camp, the agent found [[Kal Braggan]]'s [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that the thugs' leader had left behind when he went into hiding. The agent later discovered that Quelsh had murdered Braggan.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />

Around the same time, CorSec [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sola Hus|Hus]] recruited a spacer to recover some stolen goods from the Braggan's Fist thugs in their camp.<ref name="SWG:RSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Braggan's Fist Camp was a location in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Braggan's Fist Camp was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref> It was part of the quest "[[:w:c:swg:CorSec Case Files: Stolen Honor|CorSec Case Files: Stolen Honor]]" which was part of the [[:w:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy quest line]], the longest quest line in the game.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />
